_meta.purpose: Indicators of compromise to HUNT FOR in exported logs, per actively-exploited SAP vulnerability. Read by server/threat_hunt.py and attached to the actively-exploited-missing-note finding (HOTNEWS-003). Keyed by SAP Note number, matching modules/sap_hotnews.py HOTNEWS_CATALOG.
_meta.discipline: Indicators are drawn from public advisories (CISA KEV, SAP, vendor exploitation reports) for the named CVE. They say WHAT TO LOOK FOR; a match is evidence to investigate, never proof of compromise, and the absence of a match over a short log window is not an all-clear. `log` names the logical export the indicator is found in, so the hunt view can say whether that log was even supplied. No indicator is invented: an entry exists only where public exploitation detail does.

logs.logserv_events: SAP LogServ (ICM / gateway / HTTP access) — read by logserv_review
logs.security_audit_log: Security Audit Log (SM20 / RSAU) — read by log_review

2890213.name: Solution Manager EEM — missing authentication
2890213.summary: Missing authentication in the SolMan End-user Experience Monitoring / diagnostics agent lets an unauthenticated attacker run administrative actions on every connected SMD agent, up to OS command execution on managed hosts.

indicators.signature: Unauthenticated HTTP requests to the SolMan EEM web services (/EemAdminService/EemAdmin, CA-Introscope / diagnostics-agent endpoints) that succeed with no logon
indicators.meaning: The vulnerability is reached over HTTP with no credential; a 200 with no preceding authentication is the exploitation primitive.

indicators.signature: Administrative actions or OS-level commands originating from the SolMan/SMD technical user shortly after such requests
indicators.meaning: Exploitation pivots through the agent to run actions on managed systems under the agent's identity.

confirm: Confirm whether the SolMan host is internet- or broadly network-reachable, and whether SAP Note 2890213 is applied.
Review SMD agent administration and any OS commands the diagnostics agent ran in the window.

2934135.name: RECON — NetWeaver AS Java LM Configuration Wizard
2934135.summary: Missing authentication in the LM Configuration Wizard (RECON) lets an unauthenticated attacker create an administrator user on AS Java, giving full control of the system and connected SAP estate.

indicators.signature: HTTP POST to /CTCWebService/CTCWebServiceBean (and requests to /lmconfigwizard) from outside the admin network
indicators.meaning: The CTC web service is the RECON exploitation endpoint; a POST to it from an unexpected source is the attack.

indicators.signature: Creation of a new AS Java administrator / UME user not traceable to a change request, immediately after such a POST
indicators.meaning: RECON's payload is a new admin account; an unexplained admin user is the post-exploitation artefact.

confirm: List AS Java / UME administrator accounts and reconcile each against an authorised request; disable any that cannot be explained.
Confirm SAP Note 2934135 (and the AS Java patch) is applied.

3084487.name: NetWeaver Visual Composer 7.0 RT — unrestricted upload
3084487.summary: An authenticated-but-low-privilege upload flaw in Visual Composer 7.0 runtime allows arbitrary file upload leading to code execution on AS Java.

indicators.signature: Uploads to Visual Composer 7.0 runtime endpoints followed by requests to newly-created files under the J2EE deployment
indicators.meaning: The flaw is an upload-to-execute; a request fetching a just-uploaded file is the execution step.

confirm: Review the AS Java deployment for files created in the window that do not belong to a deployment, and the Visual Composer upload endpoints' access.

3123396.name: ICMAD — ICM/Web Dispatcher HTTP request smuggling
3123396.summary: A memory-pipe (MPI) flaw in the Internet Communication Manager and Web Dispatcher allows HTTP request smuggling / response splitting, enabling cache poisoning and hijacking of authenticated user sessions with a single unauthenticated request.

indicators.signature: HTTP requests to the ICM / Web Dispatcher with malformed or duplicated Content-Length / Transfer-Encoding headers, or oversized request bodies, and anomalous ICM responses pairing one request with another user's response
indicators.meaning: Request smuggling is carried in the length-header discrepancy; mismatched request/response pairing in the ICM log is the smuggling signature.

confirm: Review ICM / Web Dispatcher access logs for the header anomalies above; confirm SAP Note 3123396 (ICMAD) is applied across every ICM and Web Dispatcher in the landscape.
Check for session hijacking downstream (actions under a user from an unexpected source IP).

3594142.name: NetWeaver Visual Composer Metadata Uploader — unauthenticated upload
3594142.campaign: Mass-exploited in 2025; webshell deployment widely reported.
3594142.summary: Missing authorization on the Visual Composer Metadata Uploader lets an unauthenticated attacker upload arbitrary files to AS Java, routinely used to drop JSP webshells and achieve remote code execution.

indicators.meaning: This endpoint is the exploitation primitive; an unauthenticated POST to it is the attack and has no legitimate external use.

indicators.signature: GET requests to newly-appeared .jsp files under the AS Java web root (irj/root, servlet_jsp), e.g. helper.jsp, cache.jsp, or randomly-named JSPs
indicators.meaning: The uploaded file is a JSP webshell; a request executing it is the post-exploitation step.

confirm: Inspect the AS Java web root (irj/root, servlet_jsp/irj/root) for unexpected .jsp files created in the window — the primary host-side IoC; preserve and remove any webshell.
Confirm SAP Note 3594142 is applied and the Metadata Uploader is not externally reachable.

3604119.name: NetWeaver Visual Composer Metadata Uploader — insecure deserialization
3604119.summary: Insecure deserialization in the Visual Composer Metadata Uploader allows a privileged user to execute arbitrary code; observed chained with CVE-2025-31324 to achieve unauthenticated RCE.

indicators.signature: POST requests to /developmentserver/metadatauploader carrying serialized-object payloads, especially following or alongside the CVE-2025-31324 pattern above
indicators.meaning: The deserialization flaw is reached through the same uploader; the two were chained in the wild.

confirm: Hunt the CVE-2025-31324 indicators above together with this one — they were exploited as a chain.

3627998.name: S/4HANA — remote-enabled RFC code injection
3627998.summary: A remote-enabled RFC function module in S/4HANA fails to validate input, allowing a low-privileged authenticated user to inject and run arbitrary ABAP, leading to full system compromise.

indicators.signature: RFC calls to the affected remote-enabled function module from low-privileged or technical users that would not normally invoke it
indicators.meaning: The flaw is reached through an RFC call; an unexpected caller of the vulnerable module is the exploitation primitive.

indicators.signature: Creation of unexpected administrator / SAP_ALL users, new background jobs, or debug/replace activity shortly after such RFC calls
indicators.meaning: Code injection is used to escalate; new admin users and jobs are the post-exploitation artefacts.

confirm: Reconcile new privileged users and background jobs created in the window against authorised changes; investigate any RFC call to the affected module from an unexpected account.
